This '''individual''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Jedi Order]] and survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Living in hiding during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the Jedi was found by a platoon including the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who became known as "[[Ironarm]]" and was killed by him, earning the nickname either because the Jedi took his arm or he choked him with one hand.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi was first mentioned in the adventure "[[Hidden Depths]]" by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
